privacy.title: Privacy | Compath OÜ
privacy.description: How Compath OÜ uses the contact form: what is stored, why, for how long, and how to ask for a copy or deletion.

paragraphs: The controller is Compath OÜ, Ahtri 12, Tallinn 10151, Estonia, registry code 11502963. This page covers the company website at compath.ee.

If you write to us, we receive your name, email address, phone number if you add one, and the message. We also keep a hash of the IP address for up to one hour so the same address cannot send the form again and again. You do not have to use the form. The phone number on the contact page is an alternative.

We use the message only to reply and to follow the conversation that comes from it. The legal basis is steps taken at your request before a contract, and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries (GDPR Article 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(f)). We do not add you to a mailing list, and we do not use the message for advertising.

Correspondence stays while we handle the request and a short follow-up. We delete it when it is no longer needed, and we do not keep it longer than 24 months unless a contract or a legal duty requires longer. The rate-limit record expires within one hour.

The message is emailed to our own mailbox on this domain. We do not sell the data and we do not pass it to an advertising network. The hosting account that stores the rate-limit file is the same hosting account as this website.

This site sets no cookies and loads no analytics or advertising scripts. The language you pick is stored in your browser (localStorage) under the key compath-lang. That value stays on your device. It is not sent to our server.

You can ask for a copy of the correspondence, a correction, deletion, a restriction, or object to the use based on legitimate interest. You can also complain to the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon, aki.ee). Use the contact form or the phone number on the contact page. Please name the address you wrote from, so we can find the right message.

services.title: WordPress plugin development | Compath OÜ
services.description: WordPress plugin development, plus AI agents and workflow automation such as n8n integrations. Compath OÜ also publishes Choir Rehearsal.
services.lead: We write WordPress plugins and we set up AI agents for a business process, including n8n integrations.

blocks.p: A plugin is the right shape when the workflow is specific: a private library, a screen your staff use every week, or a link to another system. We scope it with you, build it on your site, and leave it so it can be updated.

Our own plugin is [Choir Rehearsal](/choir-rehearsal/), a rehearsal library for choirs. It is the clearest example of plugin work we ship and support. The product site is [rehearsal.compath.ee](https://rehearsal.compath.ee/).

An agent or an n8n workflow can collect a form, move a file, notify someone, or prepare a draft. Before anything runs, we write down which steps may proceed on their own and which steps wait for a person. That boundary is part of the job, not an extra.
Describe the process as it works today, including the tools already in use. [Contact us](/contact/) and we will say whether a plugin, a workflow, or both is the smaller honest fit.

product.title: Choir Rehearsal — rehearsal library for choirs | Compath OÜ
product.description: Choir Rehearsal is Compath’s WordPress plugin: a private rehearsal library with songs, per-voice tracks, PDF scores and YouTube embeds. Lite is free. Pro is €49 a year.
product.lead: Choir Rehearsal is a private rehearsal library for choirs. Songs, a track for each voice, PDF scores and YouTube embeds, for listening on a phone or a desktop.
homeLead: Choir Rehearsal is our own WordPress plugin: a private rehearsal library. A choir keeps songs, one track per voice, PDF scores and optional YouTube embeds in one place. Singers listen on a phone or a computer. Voice Leaders add the material.
Lite is free on WordPress.org. Pro is €49 a year. The product site, the demo and the shop are linked below. Role names such as Singer and Voice Leader stay in English.
what: The plugin adds a rehearsal library to a choir’s WordPress site. The library lives at the path /rehearsal/. Each song can hold voice tracks, a PDF score, and a YouTube embed per track. A player stays at the bottom of the screen, so you can listen while you read the score.
Public songs can be open to anyone. The rest of the library can require a login. That choice belongs to the choir.
who: Choirs that want the current repertoire in one place
Choir directors planning the next rehearsal
People with the role Voice Leader, who add songs, scores and tracks
Singers, including people with the role Singer, who listen to their own part

features.title: Song library
features.text: A paginated list of songs on the choir website.

features.title: Voice tracks
features.text: Bass, tenor, alto, soprano and other parts — one audio track per voice.

features.title: PDF scores
features.text: Attach sheet music and turn pages in the built-in viewer.

features.title: YouTube embeds
features.text: Each track can be audio you upload or an official YouTube embed. The video stays visible.

features.title: Phone and desktop
features.text: The player stays at the bottom of the screen while you follow the score.

features.title: Private access
features.text: Rehearsal pages can be limited to people who sign in.

features.title: Singer and Voice Leader
features.text: Singer listens. Voice Leader manages songs. Administrator also opens Settings. These role names are never translated.

features.title: Play preview
features.text: In Pro, Play preview plays a voice track from the song editor before you publish it.

lite: Up to 4 voice tracks per song
PDF scores, the sticky player, audio upload, and optional YouTube embeds
pro: €49 per year, installed beside Lite rather than instead of it
Unlimited voice tracks, microphone recording, and search by title
Play preview and the PDF score inside the song editor
From version 0.5.0, WordPress updates Pro while the licence is active
product.demo: The live demo is a shared library. Public songs can be opened without an account. Order details and an optional setup on your own site are on the product site, so the price list stays in one place.
product.languages: The product site can be read in English, Estonian, Russian, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Swedish and Finnish. Open it in your language from the links below. Role names — Singer, Voice Leader and Administrator — stay in English in every language.
